name: DropTheHassle
description: Publishes a built static site to a free HTTPS link or your own domain, checks domain availability and prices, and attaches domains already on the account. No tool spends money; purchases return a payment link for the human. Listed without auth: deploy_site and search_domain work without an account, while the account tools need a DropTheHassle token sent as a Bearer header.
author: DropTheHassle
